from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash position data for a single company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    cash_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label used in the document (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The raw numeric value reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The denomination scale found in the document, e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_data: list[CompanyCashData]
